newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher on gains by some leading scrips amid selective buying by retail investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 11.42 points or 0.66 percent at 1,739.30 on a turnover of 111.3 millon taka. Of 124 traded issues 66 rose, 55 lost and three unchanged.

Brokers said the investors were selective in trading and targetted only those scrips whose prices fell in recent correction. Apex Foods gained 149 taka to 3,720, Beximco Pharma rose 5.0 to 236 and Chittagong Cement was up 350 to 4,873.
